originality.rationale: Kiani–Maimani–Nikandish prove for a Noetherian ring with more than one relevant maximal associated prime that gamma_t is the number of maximal associated primes and explicitly choose annihilator witnesses x_i satisfying x_i x_j=0 for i not equal to j. Thus their minimum total dominating set is already a clique. In a product of k Artinian local rings, the maximal associated primes are precisely the k lifted maximal ideals. The claimed least-even-above-k paired value is therefore again the direct parity consequence of a published minimum total-dominating clique, with the odd-k extra vertex construction elementary. Originality fails by implication.

final_claim: For a nonreduced commutative Artinian ring with k at least two local factors, the zero-divisor graph has paired-domination number equal to the least even integer at least k.
